test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"disrupt."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Disrupt"** means to cause disorder or disturbance. ((किसी क्रिया को) विच्छिन्‍न कर देना, विघ्‍न पैदा करना, विघटन करना)
 
• The verb form is often used to describe something that interrupts the normal flow or process of something else.
 
 
• **Example**: *The heavy rain **disrupted**__ the outdoor concert, forcing everyone to seek shelter.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

.......Farmers rely on the monsoon or other seasonal winds in these areas to bring moisture to their crops. However, changes in wind patterns due to climate change can __**disrupt**__ these seasonal rains, leading to crop failures and food shortages.......

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Align** means to bring things into proper or coordinated arrangement. (पंक्तिबद्घ करना, सीध मिलाना)
 
• **Corrupt** means to cause something to become dishonest or immoral. (अनुचित अथवा अनैतिक व्यवहार के लिए प्रेरित करना; भ्रष्‍ट करना)
 
• **Neglect** means to fail to give proper attention or care to something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपेक्षा करना (बहुत कम ध्यान देना, बिलकुल ध्यान न देना या ख़याल न रखना))

4b:Td4b,

The correct answer is **"felt."**
